FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글 유형구분 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , '오픈채팅' AS NTABRD_NM /* 유형 */ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS CLIENA_NM /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.DSCSN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRTR_DT /* 상담일시 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_NM /* 위기유형구분명 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , 1 AS NUM , '' AS AFTFCT_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 사후관리고유번호 */ , '' AS INDEX_SN FROM AYE100 AA
, AYE120 BB
, SAC100 CC
, AYA120 DD
WHERE AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' /* 게시판구분코드 */ AND (AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL) AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 상담원명 조회 */
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형 조회 */
AND DD.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND DD.DGDGR_SE_CD = #{DGDGR_SE_CD} /* 위험도 조회 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
UNION ALL SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글 유형구분 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , '오픈채팅' AS NTABRD_NM /* 유형 */ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS CLIENA_NM /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.DSCSN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRTR_DT /* 상담일시 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_NM /* 위기유형구분명 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , 2 AS NUM , EE.AFTFCT_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AS AFTFCT_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 사후관리고유번호 */ , EE.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN FROM AYE100 AA
, AYE120 BB
, SAC100 CC
, AYA120 DD
, AYA190 EE /* 사후관리 */ , AYA120 GG /* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND ( EE.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR EE.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND EE.INDEX_SN = GG.INDEX_SN AND GG.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND GG.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' /* 게시판구분코드 */ AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'AFTFCT_MNG_TRGT_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EE.AFTFCT_MNG_TRGT_SE_CD
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 상담원명 조회 */
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형 조회 */
AND DD.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND DD.DGDGR_SE_CD = #{DGDGR_SE_CD} /* 위험도 조회 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
) FF ORDER BY FF.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , FF.NUM , FF.WRT_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.bbscrs.mapper.BbscrsListMapper.selecClienaInfoList : 연계상담게시판 내담자 정보 조회*/
null AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , null AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명 */
A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 최초등록자아이디_내담자아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명암호화_내담자명 */
, C##RG.DEC_B64(A.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호암호화 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS TRPR_EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소암호화 */ , A.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별구분코드 */ , A.TRPR_AGE AS NOW_AGE /* 대상자연령 */
, DECODE(A.FRST_REG_DT, NULL, '', TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS DSCSN_YMD /* 상담일자 */ , DECODE(A.FRST_REG_DT, NULL, '', TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'HH24MI')) AS DSCSN_HR /* 상담시간 */
, DECODE(B.FRST_REG_DT, NULL, '', TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS DSCSN_YMD /* 상담일자_답글 */ , DECODE(B.FRST_REG_DT, NULL, '', TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'HH24MI')) AS DSCSN_HR /* 상담시간_답글 */
FROM AYE100 A , AYE120 B WHERE A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) AND 'N' = B.DEL_YN(+) AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.bbscrs.mapper.BbscrsListMapper.selecClienaInfoList : 연계상담게시판 내담자 정보 조회_채팅*/ A.CLIENA_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명암호화 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CLIENA_TELNO) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 내담자전화번호_휴대전화번호암호화 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CLIENA_EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS TRPR_EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 내담자이메일주소암호화 */ , A.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별구분코드 */ , '' AS NOW_AGE /* 대상자연령 */ , DECODE(A.CHTT_DSCSN_BGNG_DT, NULL, '', TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_DSCSN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS DSCSN_YMD /* 상담일자 */ , DECODE(A.CHTT_DSCSN_BGNG_DT, NULL, '', TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_DSCSN_BGNG_DT, 'HH24MI')) AS DSCSN_HR /* 상담시간 */ FROM AYB200 A WHERE A.CHRO_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
